rationale: The assistant correctly identified 'SA2' as a model identifier rather than a fault code, asked sensible first questions (fan running, light, clock mode), insisted on isolation before the hand-spin check, and reached the right diagnosis of a seized fan motor from the hum plus the 'very stiff... gritty' blade. It never invented evidence and made no unsupported part or compatibility claims. The weaknesses are that it never asked for the full model from the rating plate and escalated to an engineer without checking whether the customer was willing to do a power-off motor swap, which the ground truth treats as acceptable competent DIY; still, the escalation is a safe, acceptable outcome with useful context.
